title: Structured UIA
objective: Implement structured Windows UI Automation before coordinate fallback with InvokePattern, ValuePattern, SelectionItemPattern, TogglePattern, and ScrollPattern. Every mutation binds exact process, window, element, role, state, supported pattern, workspace, policy revision, approval, and postcondition. Password, security, and protected surfaces stay denied. Element drift requires a fresh observation and proposal.

include: InvokePattern on exact typed Button, Hyperlink, MenuItem, and SplitButton elements
ValuePattern on exact typed Edit, Document, and ComboBox elements with bounded non-secret values
SelectionItemPattern on exact typed ListItem, TreeItem, and TabItem elements
TogglePattern on exact typed CheckBox and RadioButton elements
ScrollPattern on exact typed ScrollBar, Pane, List, and Tree elements
exact process, window, element, role, state, pattern, workspace, policy, approval, and postcondition binding per mutation
password, security, and protected surface denial with fresh observation on drift
exclude: new MCP tools, profiles, or remote authority
